objective.primary: Maximize breakout probability with mainstream, instantly recognizable film/series IPs.
objective.note: Stretch targets, not guarantees; decisions remain evidence-led.

benchmark_basis.tiktok: Fast recognition + immediate payoff; diversify beyond TV bloopers into acclaimed comedy and global tension.
benchmark_basis.instagram: Highly shareable recognizable scenes with nostalgia, villain/character recognition and clean emotional payoff.
benchmark_basis.youtube: Immediate conflict/action/payoff in 28-40s Shorts; title names the IP and the moment.
benchmark_basis.facebook: Coherent 3-beat micro-arcs from acclaimed films/series, with real scene dialogue and stronger story closure.
